title: Jeff-approved structured gold encoding of event-relationship review Passes 1 and 2

approval.statement: Structured interpretation of Jeff's natural-language judgments, drafted by Claude and approved by Jeff with explicit corrections. This is the authoritative gold for Passes 1 and 2.

corpus.state: Experiment 001 as of Run 4: 4 runs, 24 fetches, 177 articles, 620 sightings, 0 entry errors
corpus.note: Article IDs refer to this database. It was not yet frozen when this file was written; Experiment 001 may continue to add articles, but existing article IDs and their stored title/summary fields do not change.

conventions.content: Article IDs, event IDs and structured relationships only. Event labels are short neutral descriptions written for this file; no publisher text, summaries or packet contents are included.
conventions.event_ids: Global across items and passes so the same real event links up. IDs are not contiguous.

membership_status.accepted: Article belongs to the event with the given role.
membership_status.unresolved: Membership is plausible but not established by the reviewer's judgment; role is null.
membership_status.not_scored: Reviewer's judgment does not support a scorable membership or role.

conventions.document_type_note: Backgrounders use role 'discusses'; document type is separate metadata, not a role.

follows_from_basis.publisher_stated: The link is stated in the publisher's wording.
follows_from_basis.atlas_inferred: The link would be inferred by Atlas; not used by any accepted relation in this file.
follows_from_basis.unspecified: The reviewer accepted the link but did not state a basis; do not reclassify.

event_relation_scope.article_scorable: Relation connects events with accepted article memberships.
event_relation_scope.event_level_only: Relation is the reviewer's event-level judgment; its article mappings are unresolved, so it must not be used as article-level gold.

pair_labels.copy_of: The two articles are copies/republications of the same content.
pair_labels.same_event: The two articles share at least one accepted event membership.
pair_labels.linked: Different events connected by an accepted part_of or follows_from relation (listed in 'via').
pair_labels.distinct: Not the same event and not linked; 'reason' gives the cause of confusion.
pair_labels.unresolved: The relationship is not established by stored evidence; do not score a confident assignment as correct unless listed in 'alt_ok'.
pair_labels.not_scored: The reviewer's judgment is story-level or insufficiently precise for a pairwise assertion; exclude from scoring.

pair_fields.alt_ok: Alternative labels explicitly approved as acceptable.
pair_fields.constraint: 'not_same_event' means merging the pair counts as a false merge even though the label is unresolved.
pair_fields.also_linked_via: The pair also has an accepted event relation in addition to its primary label.

conventions.story_notes: Broader Story/Thread judgments are recorded as notes only. They are never event relations and are out of scope for the first implementation experiment.

limitations: Pass 1 (Review Pairs A-O): Claude's labels were sealed before Jeff's blind review, but the earlier Pass 0 report had shown those labels, so the reviewer may not have been fully blind. Claude's labels are not part of this gold.

Pass 2 (Items 1-25): no blinded Claude answer key was recorded. Items were selected by Claude with category targets in mind, and the reviewer had seen many of the articles before. Some categories are thin: one copy_of example, one advisory with a matching announcement, few follows_from cases.

Both passes use the same Experiment 001 data that any baseline would be designed against, so this gold is not a held-out test set. A held-out evaluation needs new articles labelled after the baseline rules are fixed.
This structure is an interpretation of natural-language judgments. Where the wording was story-level or imprecise, pairs are not_scored or unresolved rather than strengthened.
Pass 0 (56 pairs labelled by Claude only) is excluded.
